description: Three lanies on the diamond trail (2016). 1 series. Detective, melodrama, series. ≤️ The film adaptation of the novel by the writer Natalia Alexandrova "Three Whales and Goby in Tomato."  Katya, Jeanne and Irina - three best friends with an extremely optimistic view of life. They do not keep secrets from each other, always trust each other and are ready to save loved ones from any troubles who happen to them with enviable regularity ... troubles are waiting for them on every corner. Gathering to show a new collection of one famous fashion house, friends did not even suspect what “surprise” fate had prepared for them. But Irina was only asked to pass the disc to the host of the television program. Involuntarily, becoming a witness to the murder of the television operator and the abduction of the secretary of the great boss, Irina is not going to hide in the bushes. She decides to see the disk, and among the guests who came to the opening of the exhibition, she discovers her best friend Katya. Irina is horrified: can Katerina be involved in this dark story? The girl decides to get to the bottom of the truth on his own, and on the way not to fall into the cold -blooded killer who has already gone hunting for a curious lady. Will the girls out of this situation choose? You can find out by watching this series online on our Kinofabrika channel.
